source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/sancarlo/<unit> for all 11 units (10 Web Menu pages + the Bristol Allergen Page), every food menu downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 (linked from https://sancarlo.co.uk/menus/)
notes: A fresh run of the script on the fresh pages reproduced data/source exactly; an independent regex read of all 11 units matched all 347 items on 7 printed values and on Contains/May contain (incl. cereal and tree-nut kinds; the 67 Bristol-only condiments/toppings against the Allergen Page's own columns). Held back 4: Filetto alla Griglia and Spaghetti Pomodoro e Basilico (kcal 30-32% off their own macros; threshold lowered from 35% to 30%), Monkfish in Salsa Verde (no fish marked) and Cookie Sauce (no gluten marked). The page's own kcal disagrees with its macros by 15-30% for about 47 dishes: printed as is, flagged by check_chain.
